chunks: Drinking from the water of Zamzam.

If you are able to drink from the water of Zamzam before going out to al-Safa, then do so, and say when you drink: "O Allah, make it beneficial knowledge, expansive provision, and a cure from every illness and sickness. Indeed, You are Powerful, O Lord of the worlds."

key_terms.مَاءِ زَمْزَمَ: the blessed water of Zamzam in Makkah
key_terms.ٱلصَّفَا: al-Safa, one of the two well-known sites of sa'y in hajj and 'umrah

ai.seo_question: What should be said when drinking Zamzam water before going to al-Safa?
ai.summary: This passage recommends drinking Zamzam water before proceeding to al-Safa during the rites of hajj and reciting a du'a at that time. The supplication asks Allah for beneficial knowledge, abundant provision, and healing, showing the spiritual and practical blessings sought through worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
If you are able to drink from the water of Zamzam before proceeding to Safa, do so, and when you drink, say:
"O Allah (swt), make it for me beneficial knowledge, expansive provision, and a cure from every illness and sickness. Indeed, You are capable, O Lord (azj) of the worlds."
